name: direttore
description: Director for unattended runs in Claude Code and Codex: the runtime's own orchestration builds, a different model checks every delivery, and only what passes a deterministic gate merges without you.

interface.shortDescription: Unattended runs with an independent check and a merge gate
interface.longDescription: For runs nobody watches. Asks once which engine to use (all Claude, all Codex, or mixed), lets the runtime's own sub-agents build each unit in an isolated worktree, has a different model check every delivery, and merges only through a deterministic gate (tier, allowlist, required checks). The run page survives the session.
defaultPrompt: Use direttore for an unattended run on the open milestones in ROADMAP.md.
Use direttore, engine codex, to fix these bugs overnight: ...
